title: 16-Year-Old Guitar Star Nene Royal Wins America's Got Talent
summary:
Imagine standing backstage, your heart pounding, your electric guitar resting at your hips. You're 16, you're in America for the first time, and millions of people are about to watch you play.

That was Nene Royal's moment on America's Got Talent. She started shyly, explaining she was from Thailand. Then she launched into a thundering version of "Zombie" by the Cranberries. The crowd went wild. The clip has 21 million views!

"Once I started playing, I just stopped thinking about everything else," she told Rolling Stone.

Nene kept blowing everyone away all season. She rocked songs by Soundgarden, Muse, and the White Stripes. The bands noticed! Muse shared her performance, and she even heard from Chris Cornell's wife.

For the finale, she performed with Linkin Park, trading vocals with lead singer Emily Armstrong.

Then came the big moment. Host Terry Crews announced her name. "I'm shocked. I just faint," she said. She won the million-dollar prize and became the first Thai winner in the show's history.

Nene started playing guitar in Phuket when she was just seven. Her dad doesn't play music at all, but he drove her to every rehearsal and rocked out during her audition.

What's next? She wants to make a rock album and go on tour. But first — maybe Disneyland. Or sleep!
why_it_matters: Nene's win shows kids that years of practice — and a grown-up willing to drive you to rehearsal — can turn a shy hobby into something huge.

background_read: America's Got Talent is a TV talent contest where singers, dancers, magicians, and musicians perform for judges and a huge audience, and many other countries have their own versions of the show.
Nene grew up in Phuket (an island in Thailand, a country in Southeast Asia) and travelled to the United States for the first time to compete.
The Cranberries (an Irish rock band) wrote the serious song 'Zombie', and Linkin Park (a famous American rock band) is known for mixing rock with rap and electronic sounds.
Article_Structure: WHO: Nene Royal, a 16-year-old guitarist from Thailand performing on America's Got Talent.
WHAT: She rocked 'Zombie' in her audition, kept winning all season, played with Linkin Park in the finale, and won the million-dollar prize.
WHERE: The show's stage in the United States; Nene grew up in Phuket, Thailand.
WHY: She became the first Thai winner in the show's history, and now she wants to record a rock album and go on tour.

perspectives.description: Fans were blown away by her loud, confident guitar playing and cheered her all the way to the win.
Some adults worry that young stars on big TV shows face a lot of pressure and lose their privacy.
Guitar teachers point out that she began at seven and practised for years — the win did not happen overnight.
